links.comparator_used: Head-to-head comparison of three explanation formats for the same predictions: Bayesian networks, SHAP and AraucanaXAI, rated by clinicians for understandability and actionability
links.outcome: Clinician-rated understandability and actionability of explanations, plus agreement with the prediction
links.effect: SHAP was the preferred method because of its simplicity. Understandability and actionability were positively correlated. Perception of the methods varied by specialty and expertise. Average compliance with predictions was 86%. No per-method scores are given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: The high compliance rate (86% on average) indicates a risk of automation bias.
links.quote: Understandability and actionability are positively correlated, with SHAP being the preferred method due to its simplicity.

design_hint: explanation method selection (XAI: SHAP, Bayesian networks, AraucanaXAI) for clinician decision support
